Theorem
[Characterization of $H^{-1}$] ↗ def:norm-on-h-minus-1 1. ch5:5.9-thm-1\group Dual Sobolev Spaces

(i) Assume $f \in H^{-1}(U)$. Then there exist functions $f^0, f^1, \ldots , f^n$ in $L^2(U)$ such that \[ (1) \quad \langle f,v \rangle = \int _U f^0 v + \sum _{i=1}^n f^i v_{x_i}\, dx \quad (v \in H_0^1(U)). \]

(ii) Furthermore, \[ \| f\| _{H^{-1}(U)} = \inf \left\{ \left(\int _U \sum _{i=0}^n |f^i|^2\, dx\right)^{1/2} \; \middle |\; f \text{ satisfies (1) for } f^0,\ldots ,f^n \in L^2(U)\right\} . \]

Proof

\sketch Use Riesz representation in $H_0^1$ with the inner product $(u,v)=\int (Du\cdot Dv+uv)$. This yields an $L^2$ representation; Cauchy–Schwarz and testing with the representing function prove the minimal norm formula.

□
